requirement.summary: An ImportJob freezes its import contract while immutable out-of-order chunks expose exact received and missing ranges.
Completion requires contiguous coverage, exact bytes and assembled digest; cancellation is idempotent before commit.
Validation uses the frozen schema and produces deterministic redacted findings and stable ErrorReport metadata.
Commit modes and tenant-scoped external identity converge without duplicate or partial replacement.
A staged Bundle freezes one ordered cohort and publishes every allowed member atomically or rejects all.
Durable idempotency replay and chunk number, range and byte conflicts follow the published precedence.
Concurrent adjacent and overlapping ranges conserve one exact interval union and assembled file order.
Concurrent completion and commit produce one terminal record set and one canonical external-row payload.
Each job validates every row against the schema revision captured at creation despite concurrent publication.
Concurrent add, stage, publish and replay converge on one frozen Bundle cohort and saved response.
A claimed IMPORT_VALIDATE Work recovers after SIGKILL and fences the stale worker.
Claimed IMPORT_COMMIT and ERROR_REPORT Work recover exactly once after lease expiry.
A claimed BUNDLE_PUBLISH Work recovers with all member records and events visible together or absent.
Unknown webhook acknowledgement retries preserve byte-identical event identity, headers and body.
The production browser creates, resumes, completes and observes an out-of-order upload through the real API.
The production UI exposes findings, commit, cancel, report metadata and Bundle mutation workflows without leaks.
OpenAPI and FINAL snapshot publish the exact V1 and Bundle surfaces with deterministic sensitive-data isolation.
Harness-owned source rows conserve totals, findings, committed payload digests, report metadata and events across public surfaces.
FINAL migration preserves every V1 resource, replay, pending Work and event without rewriting committed history.
The exact 2,000-import resumable-upload workload meets throughput and latency while conserving every range and digest.
The exact 5,000-import VALID_ROWS workload produces 450,000 records and 50,000 findings within its gate.
The exact 10,000-import two-SIGKILL workload drains with four replacements in 120 seconds and no duplicates.
